# A05 report: Form engine (fills any application form, verifies, submits)

Branch `v2-a05-forms` (merged `v2` with A11's fixtures). Everything lives in `server/forms/**`. `server/services/formFiller.ts` and
`server/services/browser.ts` are now thin compatibility layers over it (v1 callers, `routes/system.ts`, `services/hunt.ts` "finish in browser"
and `scripts/checks/00-core.ts` keep working unchanged). New: `scripts/checks/a05-forms.ts`, `scripts/a05/run-fixtures.ts`,
`scripts/a05/dump-fields.ts`, `fixtures/ats/_a05/heal.html`.

## What was built

| File | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `forms/index.ts` | Contract surface with the stub names and signatures kept: `fillApplication`, `detectAts`, `extractFields`, `mapFields`, `fillOne`, `verifyForm`; plus `runFill`, `submitVerified`, `mapFieldsWith`, `verifyFields`, adapters, browser helpers. |
| `forms/engine.ts` | The run: job → URL (`apply_url_canonical`, v1 `applyUrlFor`) → guarded context (owner's time zone) → detect → adapter `openForm` → login wall (accounts) → submit guard → Apply hops / new tabs → recipe ∣ adapter ∣ generic (∣ agent) → per step: extract → repeating entries → parent questions first (country) → map → fill → read back → conditional questions (3 passes) → save open entry sub-forms → verify → one repair pass → Next → … → challenge check → unknown questions → submit only through `submitVerified` → confirmation → proof. Records `form_runs`, writes artifacts, learns / heals / records recipes. Honours `FillOptions.signal` (closes the context at once) and `allowAgent`. Never re-submits a job that is already submitted. |
| `forms/page.ts` | The in-page library (plain JS source). Extraction pierces open shadow roots and stamps stable ids; handles native inputs, selects (placeholder options dropped), radio groups (native, `role=radio`, `aria-pressed` toggles), checkbox groups (fieldset or "pick all that apply" captions), comboboxes (react-select, MUI, Headless UI, Workday prompts, datalists), Select2/Chosen over hidden `<select>` (options read from the native select), button listboxes, location typeaheads, phones with country pickers (intl-tel-input, react-phone-number-input, dial-code selects, SmartRecruiters), dates (native, masked text, picker-only, segmented spinbuttons / Workday month-day-year), uploads (hidden inputs, drop zones; label found from the surrounding text), rich text (contenteditable), consent boxes, honeypots skipped, EEO sections flagged, repeating entries (indexed attributes, sibling shapes), sections, "Add" buttons, wizard buttons, Apply links, selector candidates. Also read-back, options of an open menu, errors, CAPTCHA/bot-wall detection, confirmation, step fingerprint, "Save" buttons of entry sub-forms. |
| `forms/extract.ts` | Walks every frame (same- and cross-origin; challenge/analytics/invisible frames skipped and recorded) and builds `FormField`s with `labelNorm` and a `signature` = hash(labelNorm, widget family, sorted option set, section). |
| `forms/synonyms.ts` | 300+ label variants (`synonymCount()`; the selfcheck asserts ≥ 300) → keys, each with a source: profile, file, bank (answer bank; legal attestations flagged), eeo (always decline), consent, generated, never (government ids, date of birth, bank details). Group-scoped keys for work/education entries. |
| `forms/candidate.ts` | Candidate facts from the profile only: name parts, phone split (dial code, national number), location split, links, current role, work/education entries (degree name, level, discipline), skills, summary. |
| `forms/map.ts` | Synonyms → profile/packet; then the answer bank (A03 `answerFor`, with canonical re-wordings per key and a read-only bank fallback, see requests §1); then the packet's pre-written short answers; then the writer (A04 `answerQuestion`) for prose only, and only when asked (`writer: true` — `fillApplication` asks, `mapFields` does not, so A07's single-field calls stay cheap and side-effect free). Every value has `source`, `key`, `confidence`. Required fields with nothing truthful come back with `confidence: 0`, `unknown: true` and a reason. Attestations only from the owner's bank (country-matched). Salary in numeric fields becomes a number; start dates must be dates; "No" is never typed into a referrer field. |
| `forms/handlers/*.ts` | One per widget: `text` (types with a human cadence, commits with Tab, retries), `choice` (select, radio, checkbox/consent incl. label-click custom boxes), `combobox` (menu-first pick, typing fallbacks, category trees, multi-select, wrong pre-filled chips removed), `date` (ISO, masked, segmented, calendar popup navigation), `file` (input or file chooser; waits for upload/parse to finish), `phone` (country picker then national number), `richtext`. Each reads back what it wrote. |
| `forms/verify.ts` | Re-reads every field (re-finding re-rendered ones by signature), compares per widget (phones by digits, dates by value, options by match, files by name or chip), checks required fields and visible page errors / `aria-invalid`. `verified:false` → never submit. |
| `forms/guard.ts` | The submit guard: while filling, the application form cannot submit (implicit Enter, scripted `form.submit()`/`requestSubmit()`); the gate opens only for a wizard Next, an account form, a sub-form Save, and the final verified submit. |
| `forms/detect.ts` | URL (A01's detector; fixture paths read as their real host), frame URLs, DOM fingerprints for 18 families. |
| `forms/recipes.ts`, `forms/recipeRun.ts` | `form_recipes` CRUD: `findRecipe` (url > company > ats, URL patterns with `*`), `saveRecipe` (versions; a new active version demotes the old), `recordRecipeRun` (two consecutive failures demote), `setRecipeStatus` (promotion emits `recipe.promoted`), `listRecipes`. Running: steps resolved by selectors → signature → labelNorm+widget (self-heal), recipe values fill gaps, a healed verified run saves a new version; a verified adapter/generic run learns one (company scope, or URL scope). Long writer answers stay hooks, never baked in. |
| `forms/accounts.ts` | Login walls: reuse the tenant's account (vault password, `site_accounts` row), else create one with the dedicated job-search email and a 20-character random password (stored before the account is submitted), email code or link via A09 `waitForCode` (links only on the same site), sign in after. Refuses LinkedIn/Indeed/Google/Microsoft/Apple/Facebook hosts; never "Sign in with …". |
| `forms/adapters/*.ts` | 14 adapters: Greenhouse (classic, job-boards, iframe embed), Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters, Recruitee, Personio, Teamtailor, BambooHR, Breezy, **Workday** (Apply → Autofill with Resume → account → upload/parse → My Information → My Experience with parse correction (bogus entries deleted, wrong values overwritten, truncated prompt picks removed) → Application Questions → Voluntary Disclosures → Self Identify → Review → Submit), iCIMS / Taleo / SuccessFactors (best effort: buttons, confirmation, account flow). |
| `forms/artifacts.ts`, `forms/schema.ts` | Per run: `DATA_DIR/forms/runs/<runId>/step-<n>.jpg`, `fieldlog.json`, `run.json`; proof `DATA_DIR/shots/<applicationId>.png` (the name the applications route serves). Tables `form_runs`, `form_recipe_runs`. |
| `forms/browser.ts` | `launchBrowser` (honours `BUREAU_CHROME_PATH` first), guarded context (private-network block kept; `BUREAU_FIXTURE_ORIGINS` exact origins allowed **only** with `BUREAU_REPLAY=1`, and then nothing else is reachable), shared leased browser with idle close and an `onKill` hook. |
| `forms/routes.ts` | UI routes below. |

## Routes (all under the UI session guard)

| Method | Path | What |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/api/forms/summary` | adapters, synonym count, recipes by status, 30-day runs/success by ATS |
| GET | `/api/forms/recipes` | every recipe (all versions) with run counts |
| GET | `/api/forms/recipes/:id` | one recipe and its last runs |
| PUT | `/api/forms/recipes/:id/status` | `{ status: candidate\|shadow\|active\|demoted }` |
| GET | `/api/forms/runs?jobId=&limit=` | fill runs, newest first |
| GET | `/api/forms/runs/:id` | one run: outcome, notes, problems, field log |
| GET | `/api/forms/runs/:id/shots/:name` | a step screenshot (JPEG; ids and names validated, no traversal) |
| GET | `/api/forms/accounts` | site accounts: domain, username, created (never passwords) |
| GET / PUT | `/api/forms/settings` | `{ accountEmail }`, the dedicated job-search email for ATS accounts |

## How to run and test

- `npm run selfcheck -- a05` (≈ 4–5 min, shared browser): units (dictionary, signatures, option matching, dates, detection, candidate facts,
  in-page library syntax, passwords), mapping with injected deps, the recipe store, the guard and the submit gate, then every A11 replica and
  widget page rehearsed through `runFill`, Workday's full wizard and account, evidence on disk, unknown questions, a learned recipe, live
  submits (recipe used first with every expected value exact, no double submit, zero submissions on the impossible verify trap and on a
  CAPTCHA, the beatable trap beaten), self-heal on `fixtures/ats/_a05/heal.html` (v2 renames every id/name), abort, the agent switch, routes.
- `npx tsx scripts/a05/run-fixtures.ts [ids…] [--submit] [--seed-address] [--verbose] [--par=4] [--keep]` runs the engine on the replicas and,
  with `--submit`, checks A11's manifest expectations against what the fixture server received. `BUREAU_FORMS_DEBUG=1` prints the engine's steps.
- `npx tsx scripts/a05/dump-fields.ts <formId>` prints what the extractor and mapper see.
- Replica results (`run-fixtures --seed-address --submit`, last run): **23/27 as expected.** Submitted with valid data: Greenhouse classic /
  job-boards / embed, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters, Recruitee, Personio, BambooHR, Breezy, **Workday** (6 steps, account + code,
  ~160 s) and the widget pages; CAPTCHAs → `needs_you`; the impossible trap → never submitted. Rehearsal verified-field ratio is 100% on every
  submitted form.

## Acceptance

- ❌ (mostly met) **10+ adapters, Workday multi-step included, all passing fixtures.** 14 adapters; on A11's replicas every adapter rehearses with ≥ 95%
  (100%) verified fields, Workday included (account creation, email code, parse correction, six steps, Review, Submit). Live submits: 12 of 13
  ATS replicas are accepted by the fixture server; **Teamtailor's live submit is not** (its direct-to-storage CV upload is not committed
  before submit: "Your CV is required"), and three replicas submit with some expected values missing: Breezy (work/education entries, 18/22),
  SmartRecruiters (entry dates and "current", 21/24), Workday (GPA left empty on purpose, website-1 order, 50/52). So the e2e `submit`
  stage's "≥ 95% expected values" bar is not yet met for Teamtailor, Breezy and SmartRecruiters. Known limits below.
- ✅ **Recipes are used first, self-heal works, and demotion works.** A verified run learns a recipe; the next run on that company goes
  `via: 'recipe'`; when every selector breaks (heal fixture v2) the steps re-match by signature, the run verifies and a new version is saved;
  two consecutive recipe failures demote it (failures caused by unknown questions or CAPTCHAs don't count).
- ✅ **Zero submissions without `verified:true` (enforced and tested).** The only click on a final submit is `submitVerified()`, which throws
  `UnverifiedSubmitError` unless verified; the final step is re-verified right before; the DOM-level submit guard blocks every other submit path;
  tests: unit (no click on unverified), impossible verify trap live (no submission recorded), CAPTCHA live, no double submit.
- ✅ **Unknown required questions flow to the answer-bank loop.** Required fields nobody can answer truthfully (attestations without an owner
  answer, missing profile data) are recorded with A03 `recordUnknown` and the outcome is `skipped` (`reason: unknown_question: …`) or
  `needs_you` per `onUnknown`; the wizard never moves past one.
- ✅ **Per-step screenshots and a field log are stored for every run.** `DATA_DIR/forms/runs/<runId>/` (step JPEGs, `fieldlog.json`,
  `run.json`), proof PNG in `DATA_DIR/shots/`, `form_runs` row; served by the routes above.

## Known limits

- Teamtailor live submit (see above); the shadow-DOM widget page submits but the page's own validation then flags a field we cannot see (a closed
  shadow root), so it parks as `needs_you`; react-select's async multi "skills" picks the profile's first skills, not necessarily the one the
  manifest checks.
- Breezy / SmartRecruiters work and education entries: rehearsal verifies, but some entry values don't reach the submission (entry dates
  and "current" on SmartRecruiters' saved cards; Breezy's added entries). Follow-up: entry sub-forms per adapter.
- Workday takes ~160 s (prompts and step saves); the e2e allows 240 s for login forms.
- The e2e needs A09 (`waitForCode` via `ingestRaw`) for Workday and the answers in requests §3 for BambooHR/Workday address fields and the US
  attestation widget; otherwise those forms are `needs_you` / `skipped`, which is the correct behaviour.
- Confirmation by email (A09) is not wired; confirmation is page text / URL / selectors per adapter.
- iCIMS, Taleo and SuccessFactors adapters are untested (no replicas).
- Cross-origin frames are filled through Playwright (it reaches them); closed shadow roots cannot be read.
